```plato

    // The chord endpoint at the end of the sweep.
    ChordEnd(s: CircularSegment): Point2D
        => s.Circle.Center
            + Vector2D(s.Sweep.End.Cos, s.Sweep.End.Sin) * s.Circle.Radius;
```
